correctness.rationale: PASS: Inspected pinned RESULT.md and exact Q(phi)-arithmetic verify.py. From 12 icosahedron vertices and 30 original edges, the one-third construction gives 60 antipodally paired truncated vertices and 90 edges. Generic section vertices biject with edges cut by the oriented plane. Thirty distinct great circles for 30 antipodal normals have 435 distinct nontriple projective intersections; their oriented complement has 2+30*29=872 chambers. Every chamber contains a local sector at some arrangement intersection, so exact sign-vector construction is exhaustive. Independently reconstructed the graph and enumerated all 872 sign vectors, reproducing the histogram 132,420,180,120,20, with exact source checker providing arithmetic over Q(phi); the independent floating sign check alone is not relied on for exact proof. Spherical edge separation probability alpha/pi, with all 90 equal edges on common radius, gives the displayed expectation. The excluded finite great-circle set has measure zero; chamber counts are not Haar probabilities.
